system.effect:
Once per heist, at a moment of the ST's choosing while you're holding an item or the loot, you lose your grip. Roll 1d6 for where it lands: 1–2 the square ahead of you (the way you were going), 3–4 the square to its left, 5–6 to its right — and if that square is lower, it falls there. Someone must use an Action to recover it before moving on. That's your Flaw Moment (+1 SP).

You will drop the thing. The important thing. At the important moment.
